mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 69 degrees at Harriet Park. We have a full moon tonight, and while the ISS will pass overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Planning Department has issued a scam alert warning applicants that the city never requests payment for permit fees through wire transfers or online portals. Additionally, keep an eye out for the start of fall leaf collection beginning October 5, with loose leaves placed behind the curb.

There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today and Hop Haus trivia tonight. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and the Verona Fall Fest tomorrow, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market next week.
For our weekly report, on September 5, officers responded to reports of multiple vehicles featuring cheese slices on their windshields, identifying the activity as a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is open until 10 PM today, though please note they are currently undergoing a remodel and do not have a featured flavor of the day.
